text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What?! Dammit!
It's finally come to this?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This is an attack by the sleep-inducing organism, Sleepy-Gon! It puts people to sleep so it can take over their bodies!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I kept quiet about it all this time,
but I've been fighting a secret battle of my own...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Kh... But it looks like this is the end of the line for me.
I leave the peace of the Earth in your hands, Trainer!
Saying all that, Gold Ship laid down on the trainer's room sofa and—

She fell fast asleep...
Regardless of the truth behind the mystery creature,
it was clear Gold Ship was suffering from sleep deprivation.
